MOB-N02.rootCause: Shell root-route visibility previously cancelled a single timer serving both list and detail.
behavior: List visibility, mounted detail lease and app foreground are separate owners of one periodic timer.
Root detail covers bottom navigation and polls at the next 30-second interval while the covered list remains idle.
VisitorDetail retains/releases its lease in widget lifecycle; ordinary openDetail reads own no timer.
Background invalidates in-flight list/summary/detail reads, stops timer and refreshes owned visible resources on resume.
Session reset clears detail ownership and PII; old epoch/request completions and old lease releases cannot mutate the current owner.
Modal dismissal, whole-tree disposal, logout and provider disposal stop the corresponding resource.
testCoverage: Real buildRouter/root-modal operator activation within 30 seconds
Detail-widget unmount while provider stays alive

No passing final result claimed yet. Subsequent full coordinator run passed all 501 tests; lifecycle and disposal regressions are included. Final post-foreground-follow-up coordinator suite passed 505/505.

MOB-N05.baselineRisk: PendingVisitorCreate held requestId and draft in memory only; a committed create with lost response could be followed by a new ID after restart. Current list/detail DTOs could not reconcile that ID.
behavior: Production composition injects a file store scoped by employeeId, projectId and canonical deployment; only version, scope IDs and requestId persist.
An atomic serialized claim flushes a same-directory temporary file and renames/verifies before mutation transport; existing unresolved IDs cannot be overwritten.
Form opening and each create attempt reconcile the authenticated receipt first; found receipts refresh the list and finish without another create.

Null receipt never removes metadata and never sends automatically. Explicit recovery re-enters form fields and uses the existing ID; existing backend idempotency/fingerprint prevents a second record or changed-payload replay.
Transport ambiguity retains the exact in-memory draft for same-process retry; no visitor name, phone, dates, notes, notice payload, email or token is written by the intent store.
Read/write/corrupt-record or cleanup failure fails closed and exposes a retry. A confirmed receipt or successful response removes only its matching scoped record.

Logout/expiry/account change clear PII and visible recovery state while unresolved metadata remains scoped for safe same-account relogin. Other employee/project/deployment scopes cannot inspect or reuse it.
Create recovery errors/loading do not block updating an existing invitation; regression follows Add failure -> back -> own detail -> Edit -> Save.
Delayed recovery preparation/notice continuations wait for foreground resume; logout, session reset and dispose release waiting futures without sending transport or applying stale state.
